description: Scores and win chances for Minor League Cricket (the US domestic T20 league) and the Atlanta Open T20 from Kalshi's public live data: every game live, starting within 3 hours or finished in the last 2 hours, or one team's game. Each game gives its state, start time (ET), score, what the chasing side needs or the result, and win chances: the Kalshi market's midpoint only when its book is a real price, and this server's model from the first ball, with both sides rated equal because these clubs have no ratings. Kalshi's feed has no ball-by-ball commentary and no batters or bowlers; an Atlanta Open T20 game adds them from CricCenter, the app that tournament is scored on: the toss, who is batting and bowling, the over in progress, each innings' best performers and the player of the match. If nothing is on, it says when the next game is. The league's history, teams, grounds and players are cricket_minor_league_info's.

team.description: optional: a full or partial Minor League Cricket team name, e.g. 'Atlanta Fire' or 'Kingsmen'. Omit for every game on now
